headline: Big credit provision sinks GAAP; lending volume strong
summary_short: Starwood Property Trust posted a Q3 2026 GAAP loss of $1.08 per share on a $336.6 million credit loss provision, while distributable earnings were $0.31 per share and it invested $3.2 billion.
summary_long: GAAP net loss was $389.7 million, including a $336.6 million credit loss provision and $32.2 million of non-cash property impairments. Distributable earnings were $116.8 million; before realized commercial lending gains and losses they were $155.2 million, or $0.41 per share. The company invested $3.2 billion in the quarter, including $2.4 billion of commercial lending, and bought back a record $108 million of shares. The dividend is $0.48 per share. Management said the sharp rise in rates stressed borrowers.
confidence_notes: KPI values come from shard SEC XBRL and match the release (GAAP loss $1.08 per share, net loss $389.7M). Distributable earnings is a non-GAAP measure; the headline per-share figure of $0.31 is from the release. The release reconciliation table also shows other per-share figures for sub-columns that were not interpreted further.

drivers.explanation: GAAP loss was inclusive of a $336.6 million credit loss provision and $32.2 million of non-cash property impairments.
Follows the net loss from the credit loss provision and impairments; weighted diluted shares were about 364 million.
Distributable earnings prior to realized commercial lending gains and losses were $0.41 per share; realized losses on loan resolutions account for the gap.
Management said rates rose sharply in the quarter, pressuring borrowers, while the company kept investing and resolving underperforming assets.
